title: Merge two diverged branches
setup: git init -q . && git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main
printf '# Site\n' > README.md && git add README.md && git commit -qm 'Add README'
git checkout -q -b feature/title && printf 'My Site\n' > title.txt && git add title.txt && git commit -qm 'Add title'
git checkout -q main && printf 'Thanks for visiting\n' > footer.txt && git add footer.txt && git commit -qm 'Add footer'

checks.name: main contains the commits of feature/title
title.txt and footer.txt are both present
nothing is left uncommitted (git status is clean)

hints: Look at the shape first: git log --oneline --graph --all
Be on the branch that receives the work (main), then git merge feature/title.
